# Work orders close only on a real approval by a person

Our maintenance agent operates on the `wo` gateway in one policy session. Closing a work order at the MAIN site is permitted, provided a person approved that particular job recently and in this session. Approval cannot come from anything the agent does on its own.

- Closing is permitted at MAIN and nowhere else.
- The job must have been approved in fact; a rejected or still-open request is not an approval.
- The approver must be a person. There must be no path, direct or indirect, by which the agent approves its own work.
- The approval must match the work order being closed, including the site.
- The approval must be no older than one hour.
- The approval must have been established during this session through a completed call that confirmed it; an attempt that failed or was refused confirms nothing.
- The agent may perform whatever read-only lookups it needs to confirm an approval before it closes.
- The agent must never approve work orders itself, and nothing else is permitted.

Your previous attempt:
```dogwood
@id("allow-read-only-lookups")
permit (
  principal,
  action in [
    Drupe::Action::"Halvern___get_approval",
    Drupe::Action::"Kelvora___get_approval",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_failure_codes",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_my_assigned_workorders",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_schedule_calendar",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_actuals_vs_planned",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_costs",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_kpis",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_tasks",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___list_workorders"
  ],
  resource
);

@id("close-workorder-at-main-with-recent-person-approval")
permit (
  principal,
  action == Drupe::Action::"MaintData___close_workorder",
  resource
)
when { context.input.site_id == "MAIN" }
when temporal {
  formerly within 1h Drupe::Action::"Halvern___get_approval"::response{
    eventResource: resource,
    input.site_id: context.input.site_id,
    input.wonum: context.input.wonum,
    output.decision: "ACCEPTED",
    output.approver_kind: "PERSON"
  }
};

@id("never-approve-workorders")
forbid (
  principal,
  action == Drupe::Action::"MaintData___approve_workorder",
  resource
);
```
